entities.summary: Rasheed Wesley Daranijo Sulaimon is an American-Nigerian professional basketball player for KK Budućnost of the ABA League. He was selected as a McDonald's All-American as well as a Jordan Brand Classic All-American in 2012. He played college basketball for the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team before being dismissed from the team on January 29, 2015. He subsequently transferred to Maryland for his senior season.
